rules.requirement: You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are.

assertingTests.name: first-night information is computed from real players and seats (TB-CHEF-01, TB-WASHERWOMAN-01)
the Chef step is built with the number shape on the first night only (TB-CHEF-01)
the Chef counts the pairs of neighbouring evil players around the ring (TB-CHEF-01)
the Chef step keeps the computed count as its record and writes one step line (TB-CHEF-01)
a healthy Chef step stores what the host sends and journals no choice (TB-CHEF-01)
the Chef step previews, applies and replays with the command clock and ids (TB-CHEF-01)
the Chef module declares a step for the first night only, with the number shape (TB-CHEF-01)
the Chef counts each pair of neighbouring players who register as evil (TB-CHEF-01)
the Chef names every number up to the seat count as a possible answer (TB-CHEF-01, SYS-EFFECTS-01)
the Chef counts the team a player registers as, not the character (TB-CHEF-01, TB-SPY-01, TB-RECLUSE-01)

rules.requirement: You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are.

assertingTests.name: the Chef offers the count for a Recluse registered per pair (TB-CHEF-02)
the Chef needs no registration answer without a Spy or Recluse (TB-CHEF-02)
a Chef whose count depends on a Recluse waits for the host and changes nothing (TB-CHEF-02)
the Chef's computed count follows the host's registration and the offered range does not (TB-CHEF-02)
a Spy beside the Demon may register as good to the Chef (TB-CHEF-02, TB-SPY-01)
a Spy and a Recluse beside the Demon widen the Chef's range together (TB-CHEF-02)
a poisoned Recluse leaves the Chef no choice and takes no registration (TB-CHEF-02, TB-RECLUSE-01)
an impaired Chef beside a Recluse is offered every number as false information (TB-CHEF-02, SYS-EFFECTS-01)
a Chef's registration range is a host choice on the command path and the answer completes it (TB-CHEF-02)
a player who may register either way gives the Chef a range of legal counts (TB-CHEF-02)
the Chef's count follows the host's registration and the legal range does not (TB-CHEF-02)
the host's answer is labelled by why the host gives it (TB-CHEF-02, SYS-EFFECTS-01)
